name: Transmutation
overview: The concept of transmutation, understood as transformation or change, finds its foundation in the biblical account of creation where God sovereignly brought the heavens and earth into existence (Genesis 1:1) and formed humanity uniquely in His own image (Genesis 1:27). This divine act underscores that true transformation originates from God’s creative power rather than human effort. The mention of Nicodemus, a Pharisee and Jewish ruler (John 3:1), introduces the need for spiritual rebirth, pointing to the necessity of a God-initiated change beyond physical creation.
